datasheet.title: 2N7000G – Small Signal MOSFET, 200 mAmps, 60 Volts, N-Channel TO-92

*.source: onsemi 2N7000/D Rev. 8, p. 4, TO-92 case 29-11: lead width D 0.407–0.533 mm, thickness J 0.39–0.50 mm – the maximum values; no hole recommendation

sources: onsemi 2N7000G – Small Signal MOSFET, 2N7000/D Rev. 8 (April 2011), https://www.onsemi.com/download/data-sheet/pdf/2n7000-d.pdf, read 2026-10-31 (https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/2n7000-d.pdf answered with the technical-documentation page); the data sheet names 2N7000G (Pb-free), the part LCSC lists as onsemi 2N7000
vds_max_v 60, vgs_max_v ±20 (continuous; ±40 V non-repetitive, tp ≤ 50 µs), id_max_a 0.2 (continuous; 0.5 A pulsed), tj_max_c 150, t_min_c -55: p. 1 maximum ratings
p_max_w 0.35: p. 1 total power dissipation, stated at TC = 25 °C (derate 2.8 mW/°C); rth_ja_k_per_w 357: p. 1 thermal characteristics, RθJA max

vgs_th_v 0.8 … 3.0 V (VDS = VGS, ID = 1.0 mA; no typical value – null) and rds_on_max_ohm 6.0 Ω at VGS 4.5 V, ID 75 mA and 5.0 Ω at VGS 10 V, ID 0.5 A: p. 2 on characteristics (VDS(on) ≤ 0.45 V and ≤ 2.5 V; Id(on) ≥ 75 mA at VGS 4.5 V, VDS 10 V)

spice: assumption – level 1 fitted by Claude, no manufacturer model read: VTO = VGS(th) max 3.0 V (no typical given; the worst case for switching on), KP 0.131 A/V² so that RDS(on) is 6.0 Ω at VGS 4.5 V and 75 mA (VDS(on) 0.45 V); at 10 V and 0.5 A the model gives 1.14 Ω (≤ 5.0 Ω) and 0.147 A of Id(on) at 4.5 V (≥ 75 mA); the spread corner min moves VTO to 0.8 V with KP so that the 6.0 Ω at 4.5 V hold (sim/spread.py)

pins 1 = source, 2 = gate, 3 = drain: p. 1 marking diagram and pin assignment; EasyEDA symbol of C232838 1 S, 2 G, 3 D (edakit part import 2026-10-31) – the reverse of the BS170 (D-G-S, C111691), maker-coverage GTP 13
LCSC/JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31 (edakit part search): onsemi 2N7000, TO-92-3L, Extended Part, 1 558 pcs
notes: Small-signal N-MOSFET in TO-92, source-gate-drain (the BS170 is drain-gate-source). VGS(th) 0.8 … 3.0 V: from a 3.3 V gate it is half on at the high end of the spread – LIM.range/gate, and the spread corners of the simulation (sim.json spread, maker-coverage FT-17). The gate has no protection diode. Library draft.

checked: p. 1 pin assignment: 1 source, 2 gate, 3 drain = EasyEDA symbol of C232838
p. 1: VDSS 60 V, VDGR 60 V, VGS ±20 V (±40 V pulsed), ID 200 mA (500 mA pulsed), PD 350 mW, TJ −55 … 150 °C, RθJA 357 K/W
p. 2: VGS(th) 0.8 … 3.0 V at 1 mA; rDS(on) ≤ 6.0 Ω at 4.5 V, 75 mA and ≤ 5.0 Ω at 10 V, 0.5 A; IDSS ≤ 1 µA at 48 V
p. 4 case 29-11: leads 0.407–0.533 × 0.39–0.50 mm at 1.27 mm pitch against the footprint's 0.7 mm holes
open: SPICE model is a level-1 fit by Claude at the threshold's maximum, not a manufacturer model
vgs_th_v has no typical value (null in the middle)
the data sheet is of 2011 and names the 2N7000G; LCSC lists the part as onsemi 2N7000
